verdict.rationale: Datalab documents its own Document Segmentation capability. It splits multi-document PDFs into logical sections using a schema and returns page ranges per segment. Pipelines can chain segment with convert/extract, so one upload can be split automatically. However, the docs do not show segments being labeled by document type, or extraction producing separate results for each sub-document. missing for 10: explicit document-type classification output, documented per-document extraction results after splitting, hands-on or independent corroboration of segmentation accuracy.

support.subject: As a data engineer, multi-document packets are classified and split automatically — one upload, per-document results

citations.quote: Split multi-document PDFs into separate logical sections
Segment a document into sections using a schema. Returns page ranges for each identified segment.
Pipelines chain processors (convert, extract, segment, custom) into reusable, versioned configurations.
Use save_checkpoint=true to save parsed state for later /extract or /segment calls.
